steps.text: The Director's Cut checks for AVX at launch like the original and stops with "Death Stranding requires a CPU with AVX support" when Rosetta hides it. The recipe advertises AVX to the game. DirectX 12, so D3DMetal. Confirmed by a player on an M4 Max, who got it running once AVX was advertised (highball#514).

knownIssues.symptom: "Death Stranding requires a CPU with AVX support" at launch
knownIssues.fix: the recipe advertises AVX to the game (ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1), or the Compatibility switch in Environment settings
